description.zh: 指定要操作的API编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
description.en: The IDs of the APIs. Separate multiple API IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 API IDs can be entered.

description.zh: 应用（app）编号，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the appplication. The ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh:
环境名称，取值为：

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **TEST**

title.zh: 撤销应用APP对多个API访问权限

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者和API使用者
- 撤销前请查看添加授权记录的授权者，API所有者只能撤销Provider的授权，API使用者只能撤销Consumer的授权
descriptions.en:
*   This operation is intended for API providers and callers.
*   Before you revoke access permissions, check by whom the permissions were granted. API providers can only revoke permissions granted by a Provider, and API callers can only revoke permissions granted by a Consumer.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi remove-apis-authorities --group-id 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d --app-id 2386789 --stage-name TEST --api-ids baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38,jkscc489e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f92d78 --description Query_weather_by_region_name --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi RemoveApisAuthorities --region cn-hangzhou --Description Query_weather_by_region_name --AppId 2386789 --StageName TEST --ApiIds 'baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38,jkscc489e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f92d78' --GroupId 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d
